name: Lowi
verdict: Lowi is Vodafone España S.A.U. (the brand's legal name), which is 100% owned by Zegona Communications, a company listed on the London Stock Exchange. Nothing found.
note: Back-of-shirt sponsor of Levante UD (2026/27 home kit). Owner record changed from Vodafone Group Plc to Vodafone España S.A.U. under Zegona: Vodafone Group sold Vodafone Spain to Zegona in 2023-2024 and no longer owns the Lowi operator.
